purpose: Make canonical Song Version lineage visible and usable through the normal Song surface: show every Version in order with current and approved truth, let the artist explicitly resume a prior Version as current through a bounded reversible action, preserve approved state, and survive navigation and Quit/relaunch without exposing internal IDs or inventing analysis/audition capability.

lineage.outcome: The artist can understand which Song Versions exist, which is current, which is approved, and deliberately return to an earlier Version without erasing history or silently changing approval.
lineage.capability: Consumer-visible canonical Version history and reversible resume-current selection

why_now: SONG-01C landed real managed material and canonical Version creation on main. Whole-graph reselection now finds REQ-SCOPE-059 VERSION/HISTORY and REQ-SCOPE-013 ASSET/CATALOG as the strongest newly unlocked customer seam: lineage exists and contains real material, but the artist still cannot inspect the full history or intentionally resume an earlier Version. Live N0TE2 has no musical-analysis engine, so derivation would require inventing a larger subsystem rather than integrating an existing construction-ready seam.
instead_of: Musical derivation is not selected because the clean-room repository currently has no tempo/waveform/audio-analysis implementation despite historical Product DB foundations; selecting it now would silently create a new engine rather than integrate a ready seam.

Full Song-first Creative Studio timeline is not selected because its richer canvas depends on addressable musical objects, audition/analysis and deeper interaction; Version history provides meaningful Song structure using truth already present today.
Provider-backed generation is not selected because it depends on provenance, provider execution and a judgeable audition/decision loop that Version history helps establish first.
Another DAW chassis increment is not selected because the immediate customer gap is now how the artist understands and resumes owned Song work, independent of host.
Approval UI is not selected in this increment: approved truth is displayed and preserved, but changing approval is a distinct consequential decision contract.
completion_proof: the normal /song surface lists every Version for the exact active Song in deterministic lineage order with artist-readable labels
current and approved state are independently visible for each Version; newest/current never implies approved
each non-current Version can be explicitly resumed as current through a server-owned one-shot action bound to exact active Song, target Version and the current Version seen when rendered
foreign Origin, bad CSRF, replay, cross-Song Version and stale-current actions fail closed before current_version_id changes
resuming a Version only changes the Song current pointer; immutable Version/Asset history and approved_version_id remain unchanged
a resumed Version becomes the basis for the next imported Version because later ingest parents the exact current Version
Version material names and integrity state remain inspectable without raw Version/Asset/profile IDs, managed URIs or filesystem paths
navigation and Quit/relaunch preserve the selected current Version and complete Version history
multiple Songs/profiles remain isolated and history for one cannot be selected through another
authored consumer/invariant/restart tests remain separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution is UNOBSERVED
non_scope: branch creation beyond existing parent lineage
next_selection_rule: After this increment lands or blocks, globally reselect from the whole graph. Compare Song-first Creative Studio, approval/decision reachability, suggestion/template continuity, musical derivation only if a truthful analysis substrate exists, and DAW/OPS lanes. Do not continue by label adjacency.
